svg.title: Figure 1 · What each mitigation buys
svg.desc: Every plant fault case and the no-fault slope limit
svg.text: Every fault in the catalogue in 4 configurations on flat ground and an 8° slope, from the committed plant results: the outcome and the robustness margin rho (negative:
margin exhausted). Below, how steep the walker can stand without any fault.

Generated by tools/figures/plant_readme.py from sim/spec/walker.yaml, sim/faults.yaml and the committed plant results. Synthetic: a reduced-order design aid with no evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate). A mishap
ends the run; contact is not modelled.

g.text: Terms: CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml)
